title: Unit 3 Contents Overview: Careers, Conditionals, and Interviews
summary: A table of contents page for Unit 3 listing the lessons and topics covered, including career discussions, zero to third conditionals, interview skills, summer jobs, and a focus on careers featuring a conference interpreter.

title: Matching Careers with Photos and Listening to Speakers about Job Choices
summary: An activity where students match twelve career fields such as architecture, aviation, and medicine with corresponding photos, then listen to four speakers and identify which career each one mentions.

title: Completing a Career Adviser Conversation and Learning Zero and First Conditionals
summary: A dialogue between Ramiz and a school careers adviser about water technology careers, completed with vocabulary from a word box, followed by an introduction to zero and first conditional structures with examples.

title: Dream Careers Conversation and Second Conditional Grammar Practice
summary: A listening-and-read dialogue where Cathy and Maryam discuss career dreams and parental expectations, followed by exercises identifying second conditional examples and a grammar reference box explaining the structure.

title: Interview with Architect Zaha Hadid about Her Career and Achievements
summary: An interview in which architect Zaha Hadid discusses her childhood dream, education in Beirut and London, her 1979 London practice, major awards including the Pritzker Prize, and her view on Iraqi women's career success.

title: Matching Regret Sentences to Photos and Reading a Driving Test Report
summary: Students match sentences expressing wishes and regrets about past mistakes with corresponding photos, then read Sajida's driving test report and write her own regrets based on the failures listed.

title: Listening About Career Trials and Learning Third Conditional Expressions of Regret
summary: A listening activity where a movie director describes jobs he tried before finding his career, completed through picture captions, alongside a grammar reference explaining third conditional structures for unreal past situations.

title: Completing an Advertisement for English Language Courses in the UK
summary: An activity where students fill in a promotional advertisement for UK language colleges using vocabulary from a word box, covering topics like locations, course duration, accommodation options, and student support services.
